doc: Non-combat NPCs (ART7, docs/unity-parity.md §5): the travelling merchant who runs every shop and the pre-boss supply camps. Generated with: python redesign_sheets.py --designs npc_designs_v1.json [KEY]; turnaround with --turnaround KEY. Build record: docs/art/props-loot.md.
style: Original FRIENDLY NPC design for a polished STYLIZED 3D first-person roguelite shooter, matching the hero art of Gunfire Reborn. Strongly stylized, not realistic: chibi-leaning proportions about 4 heads tall (big expressive animal head, oversized hands and feet, round compact body), bold readable silhouette, smooth sculpted forms with clean bevelled edges, fur as a few large carved clumps (never individual strands), clothing as thick simple folds, flat-ish hand-painted textures with soft gradients and restrained edge wear, two or three dominant colour blocks plus one warm glowing spirit-fire accent. Warm, welcoming and a little sly: the shopkeeper the player is always glad to see. No photorealistic fur, skin, anatomy detail, realistic fabric or semi-realistic painting. Distinctly Chinese mythological fantasy.

chapters.npc: The merchant travels with the spirit-fire wardens through the Red Sand Silk Road, the Kunlun Snow Ruins and Zhurong's Fire Hell and sets up shop before every boss. His species and palette must stay clearly apart from the heroes (red panda, flying squirrel, pangolin, rhino, fox, bear, falcon) and the enemies (jerboa, scorpion archer, toad, apsara, fire rat, lion-like tomb beast, nine-tailed fox witch, blue bird, ape, tortoise).

layouts.npc: Output: one character design sheet on a plain flat light grey background (#D6D6D6), no text, labels or frames. Left half: a large three-quarter view in a lively welcoming pose with {weapon}. Right half, side by side at the same scale: a FRONT view and a BACK view standing in a relaxed A-pose with empty open hands, full body head to feet. Bottom right: two small close-ups, one open hand (thumb plus four separate fingers, clearly countable) and one foot. Even studio lighting, no cast shadows.

designs.name: 狸猫行商 (tabby cat travelling merchant)
designs.role: 商人：所有商店 / 首领前补给营的摊主；Unity 资产 SK_Npc_Merchant，动作 Idle / Talk
designs.brief: A plump, cheerful anthropomorphic TABBY CAT travelling merchant (狸花猫行商). Big round head with a broad friendly face, half-closed sly smiling eyes in warm amber, long white whiskers drawn as a few thick carved strands, rounded ears, brown-and-grey tabby fur with bold dark stripes and a cream muzzle and chest, a short ringed tail. Round little spectacles on his nose. A wide conical woven bamboo hat (斗笠) pushed back on his head with a red cord. A knee-length deep teal merchant robe with gold copper-coin pattern trim, sleeves rolled to the elbows, a mustard-yellow sash around a round belly, a dark brown canvas apron with big pockets, loose dark trousers and cloth shoes. A wooden abacus hangs from the sash on his left hip, a string of square-holed copper coins on the right hip. On his back a compact bamboo frame backpack (书笈) with a small roof, stacked with a few glazed jars, rolled scrolls and a little brass lantern glowing with warm gold spirit fire. Hands with a clearly separate thumb and four separate fingers.
designs.weapon: one paw raised in a welcoming wave and the other holding up a glowing elixir gourd for sale
designs.turnaround_lead: Neutral standing A-pose for rigging: arms held about 40 degrees away from the body with straight elbows, both hands open, flat and EMPTY (nothing held), legs straight and slightly apart, mouth closed, friendly calm expression
designs.turnaround_pose: , the bamboo hat, spectacles, abacus, coin string and the bamboo frame backpack with its jars, scrolls and small glowing brass lantern worn as on the sheet, the short tail pointing down and slightly back, fully shown in the side views
designs.turnaround_digits: each hand open with a separate thumb and four separate slightly spread fingers, both shoes complete.
